name: @eta-mu/gitops-controller
description: Signed GitHub webhook admission and revision-bound eta-mu review dispatch

scripts.test: shadow-cljs compile test && rm -f target/test-output.log && { status=0; node target/test.cjs > target/test-output.log 2>&1 || status=$?; cat target/test-output.log; test "$status" -eq 0 && grep -Eq 'Ran [1-9][0-9]* tests containing [1-9][0-9]* assertions\.' target/test-output.log; }
